name: Nishizawa Susumu
source: The current leader of S.O.S. He was previously friends with [url=/c73540]Achi[/url], but once Achi stepped down as leader of S.O.S. and gave the role to Susumu, he started resenting his former friend for leaving him behind. The group has been struggling under his leadership, with half its members following the newcomer [url=/c93378]Kiryu[/url] instead of him.
